instructions: Your Space is a self-hosted workspace platform: an Express server, PostgreSQL through Drizzle, Better Auth, a React web client served by Caddy, all run with Docker Compose. Journey 001 is delivered as a stack of pull requests, each adding one layer on top of the one below; review each pull request on its own diff. Report bugs, security problems, data-integrity risks, and breaks of the project's rules in .greptile/rules.md. Don't comment on wording, naming or style, and don't suggest refactors the change doesn't need.
